topic: How does congestion in feeder links impact spectrum management trade-offs for systems combining bent-pipe and digital processing?
response: Congestion in feeder links impacts spectrum management trade-offs for systems combining bent-pipe and digital processing by increasing the strain on link budget, predominantly due to heavy rain attenuation.
